selectedWork.name: DeepL
selectedWork.proof: Built and launched community, developer and advocacy programmes, from zero to a working platform.
selectedWork.caseHeadline: Building DeepL Bridges and its developer programmes.
selectedWork.situation: A new community platform for people using DeepL and building with its API.
selectedWork.responsibility: Community strategy and programme design, working with DeepL’s technical and design teams.

selectedWork.name: EU Academy
selectedWork.proof: Ran community and education programmes for the European Commission’s EU Academy.
selectedWork.caseHeadline: Making language learning a shared practice.
selectedWork.situation: German learners working through online courses on the European Commission’s EU Academy.
selectedWork.responsibility: Community and education delivery for the German-language programme.
selectedWork.work: Course-forum replies, learning articles, announcements and hosted speaking sessions.
selectedWork.evidence: Four course forums from A1 to B2, monthly practice sessions and a documented delivery playbook.
selectedWork.namingNote: Always name as 'the European Commission' / 'EU Academy' only. The real contracting chain runs through intermediary subcontractors, never name those, in this file or anywhere else.
selectedWork.logoSourceNote: EU Academy itself has no logo file (its own header renders 'eu|academy' as styled text, not an image). Using the European Commission's own official 'positive' (light-background) logo instead, since Carmelito confirmed that's the right call given the Commission owns the platform. Source: commission.europa.eu, official theme asset (2026-08-11).
